column1: #Software_Description: Software to colocalize RNA data with chromatin tracing data.
#description: This table contains colocalization information for the RNAs with the chromatin tracing data for the 4CBS cell line.
#^Allele: The allele to which this Trace was mapped. This can be one of the following values: 129
#^Sox2_Present: This field records whether we detected Sox2 RNAs at the transcription site colocalizing with the imaged chromatin. 0 is absent
#^GFP_Present: This field records whether we detected GFP RNAs at the transcription site colocalizing with the imaged chromatin. 0 is absent
#^mCherry_Present: This field records whether we detected mCherry RNAs at the transcription site colocalizing with the imaged chromatin. 0 is absent
